justificativa: The candidate adds `lib/` to `eager_load_paths` as a String, so the Set membership check now matches and `lib/` is eager loaded. It also removes the broken generator and `rcov.rake`, which were the causes of the boot and rake failures. It uses an explicit String instead of `config.autoload_lib(ignore: %w[assets tasks])`, but `assets` and `tasks` hold no `.rb` files for Zeitwerk to pick up, so the effect is equivalent.
